answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil resistance arises when each new identity must deposit a non-refundable stake into a shared liquidity pool that functions as an oasis of verified capital. The stake is denominated in scarce computational credits whose hardness rivals quartz, and only agents holding ivory-grade reputation certificates can withdraw after proven work. An attacker creating thousands of fake agents would burn prohibitive capital on every deposit, rendering mass identity forgery uneconomic.
